name: study-brief
title: Study brief and recruitment progress
for_each: select id,code from studies order by code

sections.title: Cohort places
sections.sql: select q.segment,q.target,count(e.id) filter(where e.status in ('scheduled','completed'))::int filled from quotas q left join participations e on e.study_id=q.study_id and e.segment=q.segment where q.study_id=$1 group by q.segment,q.target order by q.segment

sections.title: Run sheet
sections.sql: select e.code,p.code participant,e.segment,e.researcher,e.starts_at,e.status from participations e join participants p on p.id=e.participant_id where e.study_id=$1 order by e.starts_at,e.code

name: consent-record
title: Participant consent and history record
for_each: select id,code from participants order by code

sections.title: Recorded evidence
sections.note: Evidence record only. This is not a signature, consent request or certification.

sections.title: Contact history
sections.sql: select contacted_on,evidence from contacts where participant_id=$1 order by contacted_on,id

sections.title: Operator notes
sections.sql: select actor,note,created_at from activity where entity='participants' and entity_id=$1 and note is not null order by created_at,id

name: incentive-reconciliation
title: Study incentive reconciliation
for_each: select id,code from studies order by code

sections.title: Amounts recorded
sections.sql: select e.code,p.code participant,e.status,e.incentive_cents,e.currency,e.settled_on,e.settlement_evidence from participations e join participants p on p.id=e.participant_id where e.study_id=$1 order by e.code
sections.note: Records of payments made elsewhere. This document does not issue or authorise payment.
